title: kbgit.py publish refuses test-fixture GUIDs that are already on the public home, so nothing publishes
goal: kbgit.py publish refuses a leak-scan hit only when the projection adds it: a value already in the public tip's version of the same file (such as the synthetic query-log ids 3f2a4c1e-0000-4000-8000-00000000abcd in _tools/test_querylog.py and 22222222-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1 in _tools/test_sync.py, public since 2026-09-28) is no refusal, while a new hit still refuses; test_kbpublic.py plants both; publish --dry-run on main reports no refusal.
